developer.title: Developer
developer.body: I’m a developer working on frontend, backend, and desktop apps with Tauri 2.0. Most of the time I live in the TypeScript/JavaScript world, and I’m currently learning Rust on the side, just to make things interesting. I’m an open-source enthusiast, and you can check out my projects further down the page on GitHub. Long story short: I like having my hands in every layer of a project instead of staying in just one corner.

integrator.title: System Integrator
integrator.body: I also work on the ops side: I set up and connect complete IT infrastructures, from Windows office environments with Active Directory to Linux-based server backends in data centers. I handle the hardware, the networking, and making sure everything plays nicely together.

general.title: General
general.body: On the systems side, I’m at home in both Windows and Linux land, mainly with Ubuntu and Debian. I work with common virtualization stacks like Hyper-V, VMware, and Proxmox, and I deploy and manage containers using Docker, Podman, and Kubernetes. For security and networking, I handle firewalls, routing, and edge services with tools like Securepoint, Cloudflare, and nginx as a reverse proxy.

meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.tagline: How this website handles technical data and community submissions.

sections.title: No personal tracking
paragraphs: This personal portfolio website is operated in line with the GDPR (DSGVO). We do not deploy analytics suites, advertising pixels, or third-party tracking.

sections.title: Essential technical storage
paragraphs: Only the data that is strictly required to operate interactive features is stored.
The following items are purely technical and remain on your device or within the moderated terminal service.
list: Session cookie "user_id" to keep terminal sessions, enforce rate limits, and prevent spam.
Local storage entries for accent selection, language preference, theme choice, and terminal UI state.
sections.footer: Legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR together with § 25 Abs. 1 TDDDG/TTDSG for storage that is strictly necessary for providing this service. No separate consent banner is required.

sections.title: Terminal content and liability
paragraphs: Messages submitted through the terminal are filtered automatically for insults, hate speech, and personal data. The moderation policy is documented in the public repository.
Despite best efforts, visitors remain responsible for the statements they publish. Entries are reviewed periodically and may be removed manually.

sections.title: AI processing notice
paragraphs: Terminal submissions are processed by AI services to moderate, translate, and classify messages. A notice inside the terminal highlights this processing.
Content is not used for profiling, advertising, or training unrelated models.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may request information, correction, or deletion of data according to GDPR. Contact us and we will handle the request promptly.
Technical data or terminal contributions are removed when legally required or once the session expires.

meta.title: Imprint
meta.tagline: Legal disclosure pursuant to § 5 DDG and § 18 MStV.

sections.title: Editorial responsibility
paragraphs: Responsible under § 18 Abs. 2 MStV: Jonas Vieth, address as listed above.

sections.title: Liability for terminal content
paragraphs: The community terminal is moderated automatically in accordance with the published policy. Insults, hate speech, or personal data are filtered to the best of our knowledge.
Visitors remain liable for their own posts. Submissions are checked automatically and reviewed periodically; entries may be removed manually.

sections.title: External links
paragraphs: This website contains references to external content. We have no influence on the availability or accuracy of external pages and therefore accept no liability for them.

sections.title: Dispute resolution
paragraphs: We are neither willing nor obligated to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.

sections.title: Data protection
paragraphs: Data protection is handled in accordance with the GDPR to the best of our knowledge and ability. Details are available in the Privacy Policy.
